name: destination-brief
description: Trip-planning brief for any destination — fuses Tripadvisor's location index (POIs, ratings, addresses), a live web-context search, and a Google SERP into one grounded pre-travel brief. Three routed calls, ~$0.04 total, no API keys.

destination.description: City, region, or landmark to brief on. Free text, e.g. "Lisbon, Portugal", "Kyoto", "Banff National Park". Used as Tripadvisor `searchQuery` and as the SerpApi `q` term.

research_query.default: best time to visit, getting around, and neighbourhoods to stay in
research_query.description: What the web-context step should investigate about the destination (maps to Tavily `query`, appended after the destination name).

steps.label: points of interest — Tripadvisor location search (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
web context — Tavily search (routed x402 via SELAT Router)
SERP — SerpApi Google results (routed MPP via SELAT Router)
